Name: Eliphelet, Son of Ahasbai
Summary: Eliphelet, son of Ahasbai the Maachathite, was among David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Eliphelet son of David, born at Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maachathite stood among David's thirty.
RelatedPeople: King David; Ahasbai, Father of Eliphelet
LifeLesson: Two Eliphelets — a prince and a warrior — both served the same king.
